panels.name: Connections Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cisco  ( ("denied" OR "Deny") OR (built AND (inbound or outbound)) ) 
| if(_raw matches "*Built inbound*",1,0) as inbound
| if(_raw matches "*Built outbound*",1,0) as outbound
| if(_raw matches "* denied *" OR _raw matches "* Deny *",1,0) as denied
| timeslice by 5m
| sum(inbound) as inbound, sum(outbound) as outbound, sum(denied) as denied by _timeslice
| sort by _timeslice asc

panels.name: Protocol Distribution Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cisco built (inbound or outbound) 
| parse "Built * * connection" as direction, protocol
| timeslice by 5m
| count by _timeslice, protocol
| transpose row _timeslice column protocol as *

panels.name: Bandwidth Served in MBytes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cisco teardown bytes
| parse regex "%[A-Z]{3}-(?<severity>\d)-(?<msg_code>\d{6}): (?<action>\S+)\s" nodrop

| parse regex " bytes (?<bytes>\d+)" 
| timeslice 5m 
| sum(bytes) as bytes by _timeslice,_sourceHost
